rules: Post-scarcity is contextual rather than universal.
Replicator access does not erase energy, rare matter, specialized manufacturing, location or political constraints.
Economic state changes require production, consumption, trade, disruption or policy causes.
Government, culture and species are separate.
Institutional authority does not imply universal public support.
Current conditions should have traceable causes where historically relevant.
Conflict does not require permanent hostility after resolution.
Campaign events append to history rather than overwrite prior events.
